reply: [{"query":"根据E12A，评估新抗高血压药物时是否需要纳入患者生活质量（quality of life）或患者报告结局的评估？","query_en":"According to ICH E12A, is assessment of patient quality of life (QoL) or patient-reported outcomes required in the clinical evaluation of new antihypertensive drugs?","topic":"生活质量/患者报告结局评估要求","absence_terms":["quality of life","QoL","patient-reported outcome"],"nearest_clause":null,"rationale":"文档详细规定了血压、剂量反应、安全性与联合用药等评估原则，是该体裁指南本应覆盖生活质量或患者报告结局这类疗效补充指标，但提供页文本从未提及此类评估，属明显未覆盖事项。"},{"query":"E12A中，新抗高血压药物与非抗高血压药物（如NSAID）之间的相互作用研究应如何设计？","query_en":"Under ICH E12A, how should interaction studies between the new antihypertensive drug and non-antihypertensive drugs (e.g., NSAIDs) be designed?","topic":"与非抗高血压药物（如NSAID）的相互作用研究","absence_terms":["NSAID","non-steroidal anti-inflammatory","interaction study","drug interaction"],"nearest_clause":{"page":8,"text":"As antihypertensive treatments are often used in combination, it is important to study the efficacy and safety of the new drug in this situation.
